data.long_meaning: Derived from the Irish word 'maighdean', meaning 'maiden' or 'young woman'. This name signifies grace, gentleness, and purity. In Christian tradition, it is also associated with the Blessed Virgin Mary. The name Maighdiln carries the meaning “Maiden, gentle one” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Maighdiln usually hope their child will grow to embody maiden, gentle one and live with faith, good character and purpose.
